Hi Elena / Tom / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for DataWave ("MAP_DataWave_v0.3.pdf") and a short dependency table (MAP_table_DEPS.xlsx). The document captures the milestones we reviewed and a proposed target close date. Key summary here: 

- Proposed target close: 2027-08-15 (we can move earlier if procurement/legal timelines compress)
- Top milestones: 1) Security review & SOC2 evidence review, 2) Trial environment access (staging creds + sample S3), 3) Legal/contract review and PO issuance, 4) Pilot validations and success criteria sign-off
- Proposed owners (please confirm or correct): Economic buyer = Elena Park; Security owner = Rajiv Menon; Legal owner = ProcureOps; Eng lead = Rajiv Menon
- Major dependencies called out: SOC2 report (latest), Data ingress egress agreement, procurement PO, trial dataset availability

Action items for this thread: please confirm the owner names shown in the attached MAP, call out any missing milestones or approvals, and confirm whether the 2027-08-15 target is realistic for your side. If helpful, I can update the MAP in-line and share a new version by EOD tomorrow.

Next meeting suggestion: 30–45 minute sync week of 7/5 to finalize owners and dates.

Thanks,

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Quick confirmations and a couple of asks below: 

1) Owners: I confirm Economic buyer = me (Elena Park). Rajiv will be our technical/security owner and will validate the security milestones; I asked him to own eng lead as well for the pilot delivery. ProcureOps is our procurement contact; they will coordinate legal review but final legal owner will be our GC (I will loop her if we get to contract redlines).
2) Target close: 2027-08-15 is our goal but dependent on legal review timing — if we can get draft PO and minimal redlines by 7/20 we should stay on track.
3) Dependencies: Please add a milestone for "Legal: initial contract redlines delivered" and another for "Procurement: PO issued" with owner ProcureOps. Also we need an explicit milestone for data handling checklist completion before trial access.

I'll let Rajiv add the security specifics; Tom, any comments from your side on the integration?
